references.text: Describes how plants wither in the heat of the sun without sufficient root support, similar to how seed without roots dries up in Matt 13:6
Speaks about how plants cannot thrive without water, parallel to how the seed in Matt 13:6 cannot survive without roots
Luke's parallel to Matt 13:6, concerning the seed that falls on rocky ground and withers when it meets trials
Mark's version of the parable, which also speaks about the seed that withers under the sun due to lack of root
